name: qwen3.8-27b-fp8-pro6000ws-256k-bf16kv-dflash2
notes: FP8-weights RTX PRO 6000 WS profile for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 (official Qwen FP8, ~29 GiB; lm_head + embed bf16): official FP8 weights (dtype=auto, vLLM auto-detects fp8 from the checkpoint) with bfloat16 KV cache (DFlash2's non-causal block attention REQUIRES bf16 KV + FLASH_ATTN — NOT fp8 KV), 256K context, DFlash2 external block-diffusion drafter n=7. Drafter = syvai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-W4A16 (club-3090 ULTRAFAST/SUPERMAX drafter, ~1.28 GB W4A16 — ~2.7 GB less read/step than the bf16 incoai drafter). vLLM v0.27.1 with the DFlash2 backport (PR #52816) applied at boot. --no-async-scheduling mitigates the open vllm#50021 GDN spec-decode crash; --long-prefill-token-threshold 4096 is the club-3090 HOL flag. Rationale vs the bf16 sibling: fp8 weights halve the per-step weight read on the bandwidth-bound single GPU (the decode ceiling), which is the lever the 4x3090-fp8 ~100 TPS reference exploits. DFlash2 requirements met: bf16 target lm_head, bfloat16 KV, FLASH_ATTN backend. Repo is ~30.9 GB FP8 (81 objects) + 1.28 GB W4A16 drafter, both on R2. Requires transformers >= 5.8.0 (verify at smoke test). language_model_only removed: checkpoint ships the full Qwen3.5 vision stack (333 model.visual.* tensors) — serves text+image+video.
